perks.description: Casting your class ability allows this weapon to sever targets on hit for a brief duration, up to a maximum number of targets.

perks.name: Hatchling
perks.description: Precision final blows or rapidly defeating targets with this weapon spawns a Threadling at the target's location.

enhanced.name: Hatchling
enhanced.description: Precision final blows or rapidly defeating targets with this weapon spawns a Threadling at the target's location. There's a chance to spawn an increased amount of Threadlings.

perks.name: Triple Tap
perks.description: Rapidly landing precision hits will return one round to the magazine.

enhanced.name: Triple Tap
enhanced.description: Landing precision hits will return one round to the magazine.

perks.name: Demolitionist
perks.description: Kills with this weapon generate grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

enhanced.name: Demolitionist
enhanced.description: Final blows with this weapon generate an improved amount of grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: Transcendent Moment
perks.description: Final blows grant bonus stats based on the weapon's damage type alignment. Light elements grant stability and handling. Dark elements grant range and aim assist. While Transcendent, this weapon gets both bonuses.

enhanced.name: Transcendent Moment
enhanced.description: Final blows grant bonus stats based on the weapon's damage type alignment. Light elements grant improved stability and handling. Dark elements grant improved range and aim assist. While Transcendent, this weapon gets both bonuses.

perks.name: Killing Tally
perks.description: Kills increase this weapon's damage until it is stowed or reloaded.

enhanced.name: Killing Tally
enhanced.description: Final blows increase this weapon's damage until it is stowed or reloaded. Improves magazine size.

perks.name: Rewind Rounds
perks.description: When this weapon's magazine is empty, it refills from reserves based on the number of hits.

enhanced.name: Rewind Rounds
enhanced.description: When this weapon's magazine is empty, it more effectively refills from reserves based on the number of hits.

perks.name: Lone Wolf
perks.description: Slightly improves aim assist, aim down sights speed, and airborne effectiveness. Increases these effects when there are no nearby allies.

enhanced.name: Lone Wolf
enhanced.description: Improves aim assist, aim down sights speed, and airborne effectiveness. Increases these effects when there are no nearby allies.

enhanced.name: Strategist

perks.name: Tear
